description.narrative: (1) Support of for ENSAP Management Organize and conduct workshops to develop business plans for ENTRO, including an annual work program and budget to manange, coordinate and monitor ENSAP activities. Review legal options and requirements to facilitate the estbalishment of a financial mechanism to receive and administer project preparation funds and establishment of the same mechanism. Establish system and standards for financial management, procurement, and project preparation and management. Establish mechanisms for and provide outreach, communication, and networking with donors and other partners. Identify ENTRO staffing needs and establish processes to recruit staff. Develop and implement an institutional training and development plan to meet the long term needs of the ENTRO and national focal points. (2) Management and coordination of project preparation Develop a work program, using small working groups to develop budgets and schedules, to manage and coordinate project preparation activities and ensure the proper sequencing of activities. Provide on-the-job training and continuous skills improvement in logistics, technical, administrative support in the preparation and execution of the consultation plan to ensure stakeholder participation in the process. Develope a planning framework and process(using workshops and working groups) for the sub-projects. Establish a mechanism (using workshops and working groups) to develop strategies; prepare and submit for approval approaches for prioritizing and integrating subprojects within the framework of the regional, integrated multi-purpose program. Establish mechanisms and processes to assess socio-economic, technical, environmental, and financial viability of sub-projects and extent of integration of sub-projects within the overall regional, multi-purpose development prespective. Establish mechanisms and works processes to develop and provide options for integration and bundling of sub-projects for win-win for submission to ENSAPT and ENCOM.
